title: Deduplicate equivalent work and isolate validation state
goal: Prevent redundant Grabowski tasks and full validations while eliminating interference from shared temporary validation state, without reusing stale evidence or skipping checks required by a changed head, environment or risk profile.

acceptance.assertion: Durable work obtains a deterministic fingerprint from repository identity, exact head, normalized argv or grip id, bounded environment contract, validation profile and resource keys without embedding secret values.
Starting equivalent work while a matching task is active returns the existing task identity and evidence instead of launching a second process; non-equivalent work remains independently claimable.

Two concurrent starts with the same canonical cwd, normalized argv, exact source identity and scope are linearized atomically: exactly one process is launched and every contender receives the same task identity or a receipt-bound joined-active decision. A check-then-start race that creates two task records is a failing negative case.

Read-only tasks that consume mutable files bind the source fingerprint used for the operation identity before launch. Reuse or join is rejected when the source changes; two equivalent starts may not silently observe different snapshots under one claimed identity.

A completed result is reusable only for the exact head and equivalent inputs within an explicit freshness window; changed source, dependencies, environment, policy or risk profile invalidates reuse and requires fresh validation.

Concurrent validations use per-task temporary homes and build state or an explicit validation lease so one run cannot remove or corrupt another run's fixtures, caches or generated access-policy files.
Cheap deterministic preflight and focused tests run before full validation, while high-risk or merge-bound paths still require the configured complete validation and current-head CI evidence.

Receipts distinguish launched, joined-active, reused-valid, invalidated and forced-fresh decisions and report avoided duplicate work, false-reuse regressions, validation collisions and end-to-end savings.

Tests cover an atomic two-contender start barrier, active duplicate joins, changed-head and changed-source invalidation, environment drift, expired results, secret-free fingerprints, concurrent validation isolation, focused-to-full escalation and required fresh runs for high-risk actions.

metadata.source: Live Grabowski task and friction audit on 2026-07-11
observed_failures: Multiple near-identical full validation tasks were launched for the same repository slice.
Concurrent scheduled validations shared a fixed test-home directory and one run failed after another removed generated files; serialization later passed the full suite.

live_contrast_20260731.standard_approach: Independent check-then-start execution of equivalent read-only work.
live_contrast_20260731.contrast_approach: Atomic operation-identity reservation with joined-active or fresh-result reuse.
live_contrast_20260731.observed_result: Two process records were launched for the same cwd and argv identity. Their bounded outputs diverged while reading the same mutable candidate/resource inputs, demonstrating both redundant work and snapshot ambiguity.
measurable_success: exactly one launched process for two simultaneous equivalent starts
all contenders return one canonical task id or receipt-bound joined-active decision
changed source fingerprint forces a new identity rather than reusing ambiguous output
abort_boundary: any false join across changed source, head, environment, policy or scope
more than one process launch for one exact concurrent identity
missing receipt for launched, joined-active, reused-valid or invalidated outcome
does_not_establish: semantic correctness of either historical task output

lease_scope_migration.rationale: Grabowski owns implementation; its Bureau dependency is read-only task and validation truth.
does_not_establish: safe mutation of terminal historical tasks
